preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element a_i in the input sequence must be an integer between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of exactly two lines: the minimum number of changes and a valid sequence.

postconditions.expression: min_changes == int(output_lines[0]) and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in output_lines[1].split())
postconditions.description: The first line must be the minimum number of changes (as an integer), and the second line must be a valid sequence of integers between 1 and n.
The sequence in the second line must be a valid rooted tree parent array.
The minimum number of changes must be the smallest possible to make the input sequence valid.
